properties.name: Brooklyn Bridge
properties.heightNote: NYCDOT posted 11′0″ roadway clearance (trucks banned; 3 t posted load)

properties.name: Cross Bay Veterans Memorial Bridge
properties.restrictionNote: MTA publishes six directional height limits (page updated Mar 9, 2026): NB from 94th St 15′2″; NB from Beach Channel Dr traveling west 13′10″; NB from Beach Channel Dr traveling east 14′1″; SB to 95th St 15′2″; SB to Beach Channel Dr traveling west 15′2″; SB to Beach Channel Dr traveling east 14′0″. Vehicles exceeding a posted approach limit require special arrangements. https://www.mta.info/agency/bridges-and-tunnels/trucks-commercial-vehicle-information
properties.heightNote: MTA B&T published approach heights 13′10″–15′2″ (controlling 13′10″). Width 9′6″ bridges blanket.

properties.name: George Washington Bridge (lower level)
properties.restrictionNote: No trucks or vehicles towing trailers on the lower level. Height 13′6″. Propane prohibited (PANYNJ Feb 2026).

properties.name: George Washington Bridge (upper level)
properties.restrictionNote: Truck crossing. Height 13′6″. Size/weight rules still apply (PANYNJ Feb 2026).

properties.name: Holland Tunnel
properties.restrictionNote: Height 12′6″; body width 8′0″ for non-buses. No vehicles with four or more axles; no towing/combination vehicles. Propane prohibited (PANYNJ Feb 2026).

properties.name: Lincoln Tunnel
properties.restrictionNote: Height 13′0″; body width generally 8′6″. No trucks in center tube. Combination length limits apply. Propane prohibited (PANYNJ Feb 2026).

properties.name: RFK Bridge (Triborough)
properties.restrictionNote: MTA publishes legal height by RFK (Triborough) span and direction (page updated Mar 9, 2026): Harlem River Lift from Manhattan 12′11″, to Manhattan 14′0″; Bronx Truss from the Bronx 13′3″, to the Bronx 14′0″; Queens Suspended from Queens 15′2″, to Queens 14′9″. Bridges width blanket 9′6″. Vehicles higher than a posted span limit need a night-crossing permit. https://www.mta.info/agency/bridges-and-tunnels/trucks-commercial-vehicle-information
properties.heightNote: MTA B&T published RFK (Triborough) span heights 12′11″–15′2″ (controlling 12′11″ from Manhattan on the Harlem River Lift). Width 9′6″ bridges blanket.
